title: EWAS tutorial (GSE132203, Zhou EPIC mask.cm v8.1): checkpoint data
description: Intermediate checkpoint data for the eleven-chapter Quarto EWAS tutorial at https://github.com/krferrier/Methylation-EWAS-tutorial. Derived from NCBI GEO GSE132203 (Grady Trauma Project, Illumina EPIC whole-blood methylation), subset to n=87 (32 PTSD cases, 55 controls). Probe filtering uses the Zhou EPIC mask.cm v8.1 recommended mask (YAME v1.40); 756,251 CpGs are tested. Files are grouped into seven tarballs, each a resume point for a chapter of the tutorial, so users can download only what they need. See MANIFEST.md in the repository for a per-file listing and checksums.
